task.description:
Fix 17 failing E2E tests on branch feature/WF02-f2c-batch2-20260529. The failures are in PD-UI-01/02/03 (definition list), PD-UI-07 (export/import), and PD-UI-08 (debounced search). Root cause: likely backend not running or test setup issue where definitions are missing.

Fix approach: 
1. First ensure backend is running: .\start-backend.ps1
2. cd web && npx vite --port 4173
3. Run: cd web && npx playwright test
4. Read the exact errors, fix any code issues
5. Keep re-running until all E2E tests pass
